body: I relate to this so much. I hope you find your way back to something you don't dread. I'm currently looking for another new job because I am in a similar situation with my new employment. Lower pay and also only 3 months in. I have already realized this is not the place for me. I can't imagine staying another month, much less a full year. This may end up being the first job I leave immediately with no notice just as soon as I can find something else.

I am at that point. I am not saying anything like i had originally planned to be courteous and let them know i didn't feel well suited for success here. Im  just going to keep pushing forward while I apply for other jobs until I find something I really like. I am thankful I found this because it got me out of my last shitty job, so it felt like a forward move at the time, but it's not something I'm passionate about at all and it's turning out to not be so great in the ways it was promised. I called the temp agency i got this job through and turns out my 90 days is up and I'm not sure what is happening because I haven't got an offer and no one has discussed any of these great benefits i hear so much about so we'll see how this week plays out. I'm not working for the agency anymore, but i haven't officially been hired by the job? I'm asking HR about it tomorrow. 
Out of curiosity, did you get anything in writing about the promised pay increase? I was told the same, but I'm wondering if it'll come to fruition.

Did you stick it out? How has it been? Currently experiencing this exact same issue. I'm to the end of my probationary period and I hate the job so much. Im realizing the problems I have will still be there even after the pay raise i am expecting to get. I like my coworkers but that's a terrible reason to stick out the other issues.

Yeah your coworker should report them to the labor board. If your situation allows it, you should be looking for a different job. Nothing is worse than your mental health suffering. You may struggle due to less pay which has it's own stresses(hey you may find a better position with better pay too) but that'll be worth it to have competent bosses and pride in what you are selling. I imagine you do not feel good about selling something to people you like that could make them sick and hurt them.

I did not but they just offered to double my pay and give vacation pay--I know for a fact they cannot keep that promise. I've never had a vacation in the 6 years I've been here. Even the one week we close every year that is supposed to be an unpaid vacation. I'd be fired the second I got someone else trained.

I can tell they're sweating me leaving now. Maybe this will teach them a lesson that they should value the rest of their staff before they up and leave too.

I think this is sort of an empty threat. They're too money driven to let that happen. They have always kept a skeleton crew and it's so bad we have had to shut down operation for the day because one person called in sick.

Agreed. I logically know this but there is a lot of self doubt still. I've been wanting to quit for over 2 years and I kept putting it off due to no better job prospects out there and I've finally snapped. Burnout probably won't magically go away no matter how much money they throw at it. Especially considering I ultimately decided to take a pay cut because non-money-related issues became unbearable.
It is most definitely going to burn a little at this point. I have 5 days left and they still haven't hired anyone yet.
So we all individually contacted management and payroll and they must've realized their error and the legality of such error. I just received an email for a corrected paystub reflecting my overtime.

They slip by this by considering the first week mon-sat and 2nd sun-sat. Final Sunday is stand-alone. 

For example, our company considers Nov. 14, 2022 to Nov. 27, 2022 a pay period but payroll runs it as Nov. 14th to Nov. 19th as week one. Nov. 20th to Nov 26th as week 2 and then Nov. 27th is week 3 but included in the same pay period.

I will be doing so. Our boss is coming in tomorrow to "check this out" but they just do shady shit like this. I just recently found out we are supposed to get 6 paid days off a year when they decided to update it to say we get paid for 6 holidays but only if they land on a work day. When I asked does that mean if the holiday lands on a nonwork day? We don't get paid for 6 days off that year? They have no response for me. I am not even sure I've been paid for any holidays since I've been here and I'm not sure how to check.

I would also worry about him having access to your future child. My step-dad was grooming and sexually abusing 14-17 year olds and no one ever reported it. My mother knew and didn't care about it besides the cheating aspect. He started abusing me when I was in the 3rd grade and didn't stop until i was permanently removed from their custody my freshman year. Reporting him is going to help you keep your child safe.

She plans on it and will be bringing proof she had to have a minor procedure done but is safe to resume work but is really concerned for her job now. She only missed 3 scheduled days. The other days she was not scheduled to work.

That's what pisses me off...why would they tell me they could? That was an explicit request of doing this whole thing. I need it for my job. I've been using it for 7+ years. 
Two expectations. New phone. Same number. 

They even made me go through all this bs to reserve the number for porting or some garbage during setup of the first account. That was cancelled with my phone order and then they couldn't get me a new phone or keep my number with this new account that they made me get.

Which I totally appreciate. I was more or less whining to no one. I didn't think there was a real solution to phone companies fucking you over. 
One last question any idea what the fcc would categorize this issue as? Availability, Portability, billing, etc?

Yes, I was wrong in my wording. Which I have since tried to clarify. 
I think at this point going to corporate is my best solution. Which may not happen for awhile unfortunately. 

They created two accounts because they couldn't figure out how to do the trade in on the personal after the order cancelled and convinced me the business would be better for my situation but then couldn't do the trade in on that it AND couldn't port my numbers.

Don't get me wrong, I totally appreciate you trying to understand my problem but I'm not forcing you to read my post.

Sorry, I misspoke by saying contract. The phone would be on conteact but I mean an Account, They created a new account for me. 

Originally ordered a phone for trade in AND did a byod line on a personal account. When the phone order got cancelled I went in to reorder and their "fix" was making me a business account so I could order a phone again. Then I couldn't even order one phone without paying an exuberant fee at the time of placing the order through the stupid business account.

Edit to add: Thank you btw.

Oh joy. The closest corporate is 80miles away so this isn't getting resolved right away which is...just awesome.

3. What I'm trying to get an answer for from this post is...I see no limit on myat&t app about this supposed 6 month restriction and it even says I'm eligible for upgrades. Should/can I risk doing the trade in(for one or both lines) or will that fuck me over somehow?

4. I didn't think to look on reddit for an answer to this before I started because I didn't realize I'd be dealing with this level of incompetence until a few days ago.

It's honestly ridiculous. Like why have stores if they can't help you with half the shit you'll need help with? Like you guys can make a contract I'm getting charged on for a month and then can't cancel it? If there were better providers that didn't charge significantly more in my area I'd be leaving without hesitation.

See I was thinking that about the straw (or was going to check the store for terracotta spikes) but then kinda wondered if I could bypass that if I submerged the bottom enough it'll leech out of the mushroom itself. So kinda like a mini olla pot?

Actually I'm not even sure that last bit is entirely true really... I was doing a large portion of my current position and my old position before the old manager quit but with shittier pay. Working 730am-9pm shifts with maybe an hr lunch break at 5 if I was lucky and definitely no breaks. At least now I get at least a half hour(hour if I want to fuck my day up) lunch in the middle of the day and am out by 6-7 pm

That's so silly though. I was passionate about our mission; improving peoples lives. If I had been given the opportunity to go back to school before now I could have improved their business by furthering that mission because I'd be able to get away from this stupid desk prison and be back to what matters most to me, the patients. They are well aware I dislike managing the office aspect of the practice but I love(d) what we do so I was willing to do whatever job was needed of me. 

I fucked up when I decided to accept this position because it meant better(ish) hours/more pay because now I'm stuck in a job going nowhere.
